meta.name: positioning-workshop
meta.description: Run a positioning workshop that surfaces target customer, unmet need, category, benefits, and differentiation. Use when your product messaging feels fuzzy, generic, or misaligned.

copy.tagline: 梳理产品定位，明确目标客户与差异化优势
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果产品信息模糊、缺乏差异化，需要清晰定位
copy.tagline_en: Clarify product positioning, target customers, and differentiation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your product messaging feels fuzzy and needs clear positioning

howto.what: 引导你完成产品定位的发现过程，通过提问明确目标客户、未满足需求、产品类别、核心收益和差异化优势，最终生成一份定位声明。
howto.when: 当你的产品信息模糊、泛泛或与市场脱节时，或者在新产品定义定位、重新定位现有产品、准备发布前使用。

say.text: 帮我为我们的B2B分析工具办一个定位工作坊。
我们的信息太泛了，引导一次定位会议。
我们需要明确服务谁以及为什么与众不同。

howto.what_en: Guides you through a structured discovery process to articulate product positioning by asking adaptive questions about target customers, unmet needs, category, benefits, and differentiation, outputting a positioning statement.
howto.when_en: Use when your product messaging feels fuzzy, generic, or misaligned, or before writing PRDs, launch plans, or marketing materials to align stakeholders on strategic positioning.

say_en.text: Run a positioning workshop for our B2B analytics tool.
Our messaging is too generic. Facilitate a positioning session.
We need to define who we serve and why we're different.
